purpose: Phase 2 corpus precondition gate: verify Option D is a live (novel) destination and re-scope C1 BEFORE freezing the decision rule.

evidence.title: Token Reduction Is Not Cost Reduction: An Empirical Study of End-to-End Efficiency in API-Based Coding Agents
evidence.why_it_preempts: Explicitly decomposes token change into a per-turn savings term and a trajectory (Delta turns) term over PAIRED blocks, with success-adjusted end-to-end cost as the primary metric, on coding agents (SWE-bench Go subset). This is the replay-vs-trajectory decomposition Option D planned, done with a stronger paired-counterfactual, provider-billed design.

evidence.title: What Does Context Compression Cost an Agent? Interaction Costs Unrevealed by Task-Completion Metrics
evidence.why_it_preempts: Thesis is that completion/cumulative metrics hide compression's interaction (trajectory) costs; uses paired counterfactual state injection to attribute reacquisition cost. Same core claim as Option D.

evidence.title: Toward Reliable Context Compression for Long-Horizon Agents: Execution Instability
evidence.why_it_preempts: Paired PRE/POST-compression control from the same execution state; marginal per-step effects. Same paired-replay methodology family.

option_D_novelty.what_survives: The paper's ANALYTIC budget-recurrence model (Eqs 4-8) DERIVES the replay term a priori from S, O_k, A_k recurrence; the pre-empting papers MEASURE the split empirically but do not derive it from a recurrence model. A theory-vs-measurement framing (does the observed replay/trajectory split match the analytic prediction, on an open self-hosted model) is the narrow surviving novelty. The pure 'we decompose' framing is no longer novel.

C1_absence_claim.note: No paper found that composes TWO SEPARATE methods from different intervention-point categories with individual baselines, so C1's literal Boolean is borderline-survivable. But the corpus missed several obvious in-scope papers, and multiple single methods now span categories, so C1's significance as a headline gap is weak.

SAC_equals_cost_of_pass.note: Draft 6.3 SAC = sum PT / sum success is cost-of-pass v=C/R (arXiv:2504.13359, used by Efficient Agents 2508.02694; see also AI Agents That Matter 2407.01502, CLEAR/CNA). Must be relabelled and cited.

arxiv:2607.12161.note: studies RTK specifically (same tool as this paper); pre-specified hash-frozen paired campaign; reaches compatible conclusion by paired provider-billed design

arxiv:2604.03679_LightThinker++.relation_to_freeze: BEFORE freeze -> genuine PRIOR ART for C1 category-spanning; missed in original corpus

arxiv:2407.01502_AIAgentsThatMatter.relation_to_freeze: prior art on eval rigor / cost-of-pass; adjacent to but does NOT pre-empt the process-based degeneracy diagnostic (that is a per-run determinism/duplication filter, a different contribution); frame degeneracy as supporting artifact, not headline

decision.null_branch_redefined_to: D-prime: analytic budget-recurrence model (Eqs 4-8) that PREDICTS the replay/trajectory split a priori, calibrated against measured runs; experiments reframed from hypothesis-test to CALIBRATION data (a result either way); concurrent work (2607.12161, 2608.16370) cited as independent corroboration by different means. This survives because the concurrent papers MEASURE the split post hoc but do not DERIVE its magnitude from a recurrence model.
decision.primary_selection_basis: Process integrity, decided pre-outcome: E1 has ZERO degeneracy, needs NO post-treatment filtering, and retains full 6-task coverage in all 4 cells. E2 degeneracy loads on the CoD arms (28 vs 24; distinct non-degenerate tasks drop 6->5), so filtering E2 to obtain the interaction is post-treatment conditioning on a collider (the Amendment 2 problem via a different door). E2's larger raw effective-n (17-18) is illusory because reaching it requires a collider-inducing filter. E2 is therefore reported descriptively/secondary, with the collider caveat.
decision.freeze_discipline: Freeze only if both branch outcomes are acceptable landing places; YAML records a per-branch one-sentence description so the asymmetry is on the record.

consequence_for_freeze: Option D redefined to D-prime BEFORE freeze (gate satisfied). Primary=E1 on process-integrity grounds. Proceed to Phase 3 freeze.
